    • issuer

      public McpDynamicClientRegistrar.Builder issuer(URI value)
      Sets the AS issuer these credentials are being registered with. Required.

      Stamped onto the resulting McpClientRegistration as the SEP-2352 credential-binding key.

      Parameters:
      value - The issuer URI.
      Returns:
      This object.
